content_sections.heading: NCCS Job Description
content_sections.text: Security Certification: Responsible for the framework of issuing security certificates for tested telecom equipment, including evaluation of test results and recommending certification. Security Assurance Standards: Developing ITSARs, test procedures, best current practices, identification of security test tools, and managing the Security Assurance Standards Facility (SASF). Security Lab Recognition: Notifying TSTL designation mechanisms, conducting activities associated with TSTL designation, and issuing certificates. Headquarters: General administration, staff and establishment matters, public grievance redressal, RTI queries, training, capacity building, iGoT matters, procurement, budget and audit, workshops, conferences, and handling court cases.

content_sections.heading: Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: Qualification required: Holding analogous post on regular basis in the parent cadre or department; Or with six years' service rendered after appointment to the post on a regular basis in level-5 in the pay matrix (Rs. 29200-92300) or equivalent; Bachelor degree in Engineering or Technology in Electrical / Electronics / Electronics & Communications / Computer Science / Telecommunications / IT / Instrumentation. Age limit: Maximum 56 years. Pay: Level 6 of pay matrix (Rs. 35,400 - 1,12,400). Qualification required: Holding analogous post on regular basis in the parent cadre or department; Or with five years' service rendered after appointment to the post on a regular basis in level 4 in the pay matrix (Rs. 25500-81100); Or with ten years' service rendered after appointment to the post on a regular basis in level 3 in the pay matrix (Rs. 21700-69100); Minimum three years Engineering Diploma in Telecommunications / Electronics / Computer Science / IT / Cyber Security / Big Data / IoT / Instrumentation or B.Sc in Electronics / Computer Science / IT. Age limit: Maximum 56 years. Pay: Level 5 of pay matrix (Rs. 29,900 - 92,300). Qualification required: Holding analogous post on regular basis in the parent cadre or department; Or with three years service rendered after appointment to the post on a regular basis in level-1 in the pay matrix (Rs. 18000-56900); 12th pass from a recognized Board; Typing speed of 35 w.p.m. in English or 30 w.p.m. in Hindi on computer. Age limit: Maximum 56 years. Pay: Level 2 of pay matrix (Rs. 19,900 - 63,200).

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Pay and terms of deputation follow DoT OM dated 31.10.2023 and corrigendum dated 01.11.2023, and DoPT OM dated 28.03.2024. Period of deputation for JE(T) shall ordinarily not exceed three years Period of deputation for TA and LDC shall be for an initial period of 1 year which may be further extended

content_sections.heading: How Will NCCS Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Selection procedure as decided by the Head of NCCS Screening of applications and verification of records Decision of the department in the matter of selection through deputation shall be final and binding

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Application in prescribed proforma - Annexure 'B' Statement giving details of Major/Minor penalties imposed during the last (10) years Vigilance clearance and Integrity Certificate Copy of latest Month Salary Slip Copy of official ID card Copy of proof of present address and identity Photocopies of ACRs/APARs for the last five (5) years duly attested Certificate recorded by Department Head - Annexure 'D'

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NCCS Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Fill out the application form in Annexure 'B'. Attach all required documents including ACR/APARs for the last 5 years and vigilance clearance. Forward through proper channel from Cadre Controlling Authorities / Head of Department. Send the complete application to ADET (HQ), Room 301, NCCS, 3rd floor, City Telephone Exchange, 4th Main, Sampangi Rama Nagar, Bengaluru (Kar.) - 560027. Make sure it reaches by 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NCCS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in NCCS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 4 vacancies: 1 Junior Engineer (Telecom), 2 Telecom Assistant (TA), 1 Lower Division Clerk (LDC).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for NCCS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Annexure 'B') and send it to ADET (HQ), Room 301, NCCS, 3rd floor, City Telephone Exchange, 4th Main, Sampangi Rama Nagar, Bengaluru (Kar.) - 560027, by through proper channel, to reach by 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 56 years (on the closing date of receipt of applications).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Level 6 of pay matrix (Rs. 35,400 - 1,12,400) for Junior Engineer (Telecom), Level 5 of pay matrix (Rs. 29,900 - 92,300) for Telecom Assistant (TA), Level 2 of pay matrix (Rs. 19,900 - 63,200) for Lower Division Clerk (LDC).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Bachelor degree in Engineering or Technology for JE(T); Minimum three years Engineering Diploma in Telecommunications / B.Sc for TA; 12th pass with typing speed for LDC. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only officers whose services can be spared immediately on selection will be considered.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications received after the last date. Applications not forwarded through proper channel. Applications without prescribed documents or incomplete applications.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Selection procedure as decided by the Head of NCCS. Screening of applications and verification of records. Decision of the department in the matter of selection through deputation shall be final and binding.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Period of deputation for JE(T) shall ordinarily not exceed three years. Period of deputation for TA and LDC shall be for an initial period of 1 year which may be further extended.
